Build kit for "of and with statuses"

Start from the TEMPLATE, fill it with BLOCKS, and use COMPONENTS only for what is left.
Changing a page you already have? Keep it, and use only the blocks and components.

TEMPLATE
Search matched `dashboard-progress`, `dashboard-alert-rail`, `dashboard-scorecard` only loosely, so start from the app shell. Scaffold it, then put blocks inside it.

name:        shell-top-nav
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Application frame with horizontal navigation only: a centered bar whose items open full-width mega-menu panels, over placeholder content that keeps the entire width.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template shell-top-nav --type page <path>

Install missing dependencies: npm install @heroicons/react@"^2.2.0"

This template uses StyleX. Your project needs a StyleX compiler plugin - see `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs styling-overview` for setup steps.

Keyword search matched these page templates: dashboard-progress (@astryxdesign/core), dashboard-alert-rail (@astryxdesign/core), dashboard-scorecard (@astryxdesign/core).

BLOCKS
Ready-made sections for parts the template lacks (top 3 of 5; --verbose for all). Print one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template <name>

name:        ChatToolCallsStatuses
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: All four status states (pending, running, complete, and error) shown together in a single group.

name:        BannerStatuses
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: All 4 banner statuses: info, success, warning, and error.

name:        useIconHookUsage
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: A custom status row that draws the semantic success, warning and error icons with useIcon.

COMPONENTS
For what the template and blocks do not cover (top 3 of 6; --verbose for all). Read one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component <name>

name:        Banner
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Banner shows a persistent message at the top of a page or section.

name:        ChatToolCalls
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: ChatToolCalls displays tool or function call invocations from an LLM response.

name:        StatusDot
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: A small colored dot that communicates status like online/offline presence or severity levels.
